harm.sentenceEn: Taking medicine at the wrong time can even cause harm .
harm.translationZh: 在错误的时间服药甚至可能对身体造成伤害。
harm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

harm.sentenceEn: "For now, I think the negative reputation around games means that telling someone you're a determined gamer is more likely to harm your chances of getting a job. But if someone can explain how they've led a team in an online game, for example, they may be able to persuade an employer that this is useful," says Dr Barr.
harm.translationZh: 巴尔博士表示：“目前，我认为针对游戏的负面评价意味着，告诉别人你是一名资深玩家更有可能损害你的求职机会。但如果有人能够解释他们是如何在网络游戏中领导团队的，他们或许就能说服雇主，证明这项经历是有用的。”

harm.sentenceEn: The article also explained how advertising campaigns specifically target very young and poor people, causing harm for these vulnerable groups.
harm.translationZh: 文章还解释了广告活动是如何专门针对青少年和贫困群体的，而这正在对这些弱势群体造成伤害。
harm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

harm.sentenceEn: It defies our increasing awareness of the harm plastics do to the environment and a broader, growing sense that something has to change.
harm.translationZh: 这与我们对塑料危害环境的日益认识以及一种日益普遍的共识——即必须做出改变——背道而驰。

harm.sentenceEn: What should be done first to eliminate the harm caused by the clothing industry?
harm.translationZh: 要消除服装行业造成的危害，首先应该做什么？

harm.sentenceEn: It may do as much harm as good.

hire.sentenceEn: Even the military is hiring gamers.
hire.translationZh: 连军方都在招募游戏玩家。

hire.sentenceEn: Hiring managers admit they are reluctant to hire those over 40 or 45, arguing they probably won't be a good "fit," their experience won't be relevant to the workplace, and they'll be unable or unwilling to learn new skills.
hire.translationZh: 招聘经理坦言，他们不太愿意雇佣 40 或 45 岁以上的人，理由是这些人可能无法融入团队文化、过往经验与当前职场脱节，且缺乏学习新技能的能力或意愿。

hire.sentenceEn: Hiring managers said training was three times more likely to get them to hire applicants over age 45 than, say, government subsidies(补贴).
hire.translationZh: 招聘经理表示，相比于政府补贴等手段，通过培训使他们雇佣45岁以上申请人的可能性要高出三倍。

hire.sentenceEn: Hiring managers are three times as likely to rate job applicants age 35 – 44 as a better "fit" than those over 45.
hire.translationZh: 招聘经理认为 35 至 44 岁应聘者的“匹配度”比 45 岁以上应聘者高出三倍的可能性更高。

hire.sentenceEn: Hiring managers who are not yet 45 years old seem unwilling to hire people their senior.
hire.translationZh: 不满45岁的招聘经理似乎不愿录用年龄比他们大的应聘者。

hire.sentenceEn: They have fewer chances to be hired by U.S. companies.
hire.translationZh: 他们被美国公司雇佣的机会更少。

household.sentenceEn: As annual inflation climbs over 10%, many households are on tight budgets.
household.translationZh: 随着年通货膨胀率攀升至10%以上，许多家庭的预算都变得非常紧张。
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

household.sentenceEn: A retired vice president from a major chemical company stated, "Young women engineers are on an equal footing until they have children, then they struggle to balance work and family—and compete with men who don't have the same household responsibilities."
household.translationZh: 一家大型化工公司的退休副总裁表示：“年轻女性工程师在生育前与男性处于平等地位，但有了孩子后，她们就要艰难地平衡工作与家庭，还要和那些没有同等家庭责任的男性竞争。”
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

household.sentenceEn: Natural gas is used by nearly half of U.S. households for heat.
household.translationZh: 美国近一半的家庭使用天然气供暖。
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

household.sentenceEn: A household pet can also cultivate a child's sense of responsibility as their parent explains the necessary processes of keeping their pet happy and healthy.
household.translationZh: 当父母向孩子解释如何让宠物保持快乐健康的必要过程时，家庭宠物也能培养孩子的责任感。
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

household.sentenceEn: And of course, if a child doesn't have a pet in their own household , they can still benefit from all of the above when visiting a friend who does.
household.translationZh: 当然，如果孩子自己家里没有养宠物，他们去有宠物的朋友家做客时仍然能享受到上述所有好处。
household.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

household.sentenceEn: What does research reveal about adults in food-insecure households ?
household.translationZh: 研究揭示了粮食不安全家庭的成年人有什么特点？

harmful.sentenceEn: "We consume compounds every day that may be poisonous and our bodies do a wonderful job of removing and eliminating anything harmful from our bodies."
harmful.translationZh: 我们每天都会摄入一些可能有毒的化合物，而我们的身体在清除和排出体内有害物质方面做得非常出色。

harmful.sentenceEn: Aside from the link to type 2 diabetes, many studies agree that fruit juice is harmful if it contributes to an excess in calories.
harmful.translationZh: 除了与2型糖尿病有关联外，许多研究一致认为，如果果汁导致热量摄入过剩，那么它是有害的。

harmful.sentenceEn: However, "the whole concept of a juice diet helping to remove poisonous or harmful substances from the body is completely false," says Clemens.
harmful.translationZh: 然而，克莱门斯说：“果汁饮食有助于清除体内有毒或有害物质的整个概念是完全错误的。”

harmful.sentenceEn: Most foods containing fructose—a naturally occurring sugar found in all fruits and fruit juices—don't seem to have harmful effects as long as they're not contributing to excess daily calories.
harmful.translationZh: 大多数含有果糖（一种存在于所有水果和果汁中的天然糖分）的食物，只要不导致每日热量摄入过剩，似乎就不会产生有害影响。

harmful.sentenceEn: Some people believe a juice diet helps to rid our body of harmful or poisonous substances.
harmful.translationZh: 有些人认为果汁饮食有助于清除体内的有害物质或毒素。

harmful.sentenceEn: It is harmful to mankind to use human-made materials.
harmful.translationZh: 使用人造材料对人类有害。

housing.sentenceEn: M: Well, I know a great housing agent.
housing.translationZh: 男：嗯，我认识一位很棒的房产中介。
housing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

housing.sentenceEn: M: Yes, but I think that dream needs to change, considering the cost of housing .
housing.translationZh: 男：是的，但考虑到住房成本，我觉得那个梦想需要改变了。
housing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

housing.sentenceEn: W: Housing costs are high, but do people really save that much by having a smaller home?
housing.translationZh: 女：住房成本很高，但人们住小一点的房子真的能省那么多钱吗？
housing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

housing.sentenceEn: The trend for bigger housing thus poses ethical questions.
housing.translationZh: 因此，这种追求更大住房的趋势引发了伦理问题。
housing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

housing.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say about the housing project?
housing.translationZh: 说话者对住房项目有什么说法？

housing.sentenceEn: Send her his housing agent's telephone number.
housing.translationZh: 把他的房屋中介的电话号码发给她。

handle.sentenceEn: Severe weather that causes cancellation or delay is more likely in regions that are less able to handle the situation.
handle.translationZh: 导致航班取消或延误的恶劣天气，更可能发生在应对能力较弱的地区。

handle.sentenceEn: In order to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace, you need to understand how to handle conflicts and reach agreements.
handle.translationZh: 要在工作场所掌握说服的艺术，你需要了解如何处理冲突并达成共识。
handle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

handle.sentenceEn: Poor sleep might be a problem for older people, but surely young people can handle late nights.
handle.translationZh: 睡眠不足对老年人来说可能是个问题，但年轻人肯定能应付熬夜。
handle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

handle.sentenceEn: "I handle my own gold medal so gently that I would not scratch it."
handle.translationZh: 我对自己的金牌呵护备至，连一丝刮痕都不忍让它有。
handle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

handle.sentenceEn: How did Sao Paulo city officials handle Alexandre Orion's reverse graffiti?
handle.translationZh: 圣保罗市官员是如何处理亚历山大·奥利翁的反向涂鸦的？

handle.sentenceEn: People can improve their capabilities by handling multitasking situations.
handle.translationZh: 人们可以通过处理多任务情境来提升自己的能力。

highly.sentenceEn: He was highly productive and his amazing body of work is considered fascinating by the critics.
highly.translationZh: 他工作效率极高，其惊人的作品被评论家们视为极具魅力。
highly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

highly.sentenceEn: Most imitation meats are highly processed and contain high amounts of sodium(钠) compared to traditional beef.
highly.translationZh: 大多数人造肉属于高度加工食品，与传统牛肉相比钠含量也更高。
highly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

highly.sentenceEn: So embrace the cliché(老话) and love yourself as it's highly doubtful that you'll regret it.
highly.translationZh: 所以就接受这句老话吧，好好爱自己——你几乎肯定不会后悔的。
highly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

highly.sentenceEn: According to a recent study, one in five highly engaged employees is at risk of burnout(精疲力竭).
highly.translationZh: 根据最近的一项研究，每五名高度投入的员工中就有一名面临精疲力竭的风险。
highly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

highly.sentenceEn: Why should one be highly focused when doing extreme sports?
highly.translationZh: 为什么从事极限运动时需要高度专注？

highly.sentenceEn: Improved technology gives birth to highly popular products.
highly.translationZh: 先进的技术催生广受欢迎的产品。

happiness.sentenceEn: Experts say too much happiness can stop the bears from searching for new mates.
happiness.translationZh: 专家表示，过度安逸会使熊类停止寻找新伴侣。
happiness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

happiness.sentenceEn: This implies that even though ambitious people are more likely to achieve conventional "success," such success means nothing for their health and happiness —and if you don't have health and happiness , what else could possibly matter?
happiness.translationZh: 这意味着，尽管有抱负的人更容易取得传统意义上的"成功"，但这种成功对他们的健康和幸福毫无意义——如果你没有健康和幸福，还有什么可能更重要呢？
happiness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

happiness.sentenceEn: Despite this, popular culture and the housing industry market happiness as living with both more space and more amenities(便利设施).
happiness.translationZh: 尽管如此，流行文化和房地产行业却将幸福宣传为拥有更大空间和更多便利设施的生活。
happiness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

happiness.sentenceEn: One recent study published in the journal PLOS ONE, for example, found that the strength of a person's social circle was a better indicator of self-reported stress, happiness and well-being levels than fitness tracker data on physical activity, heart rate and sleep.
happiness.translationZh: 例如，近期发表在《公共科学图书馆·综合》(PLOS ONE)期刊上的一项研究发现，一个人的社交圈强度比健身追踪器记录的身体活动、心率和睡眠数据更能反映其自我报告的压力、幸福感和健康水平。
happiness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

happiness.sentenceEn: Which country experienced the biggest decline in happiness according to the survey?
happiness.translationZh: 根据调查，哪个国家的幸福感下降幅度最大？

happiness.sentenceEn: Prioritize health and happiness over material success.
happiness.translationZh: 将健康和幸福置于物质成功之上。

highway.sentenceEn: The main alternative to increasing traffic throughput per lane has been to build more lanes and more highways , and putting in new roads is very expensive, he said.
highway.translationZh: 他表示，除了提高单车道的交通吞吐量外，主要的替代方案一直是修建更多车道和高速公路，而新建道路的成本非常高昂。

highway.sentenceEn: "If we can increase the throughput on major highways , even if it's only by 50 percent, that would be a big deal," Horn said.
highway.translationZh: 霍恩表示：“如果我们能提高主要高速公路的通行能力，即便只提升50%，那也将是件大事。”

highway.sentenceEn: Horn said phantom traffic jams are an emergent property of the flow of vehicles down a highway .
highway.translationZh: 霍恩表示，幽灵交通拥堵是高速公路上车辆流动的一种涌现特性。

highway.sentenceEn: A police officer in the U.S. stopped a large SUV car that was going very slowly and drifting across lanes on a highway .
highway.translationZh: 美国一名警察拦下了一辆在高速公路上行驶非常缓慢且左右变道的大型SUV。
highway.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

highway.sentenceEn: When was the Interstate Highway System mostly completed?
highway.translationZh: 州际公路系统大致是在什么时候完成的？

highway.sentenceEn: He left his paintings at a highway rest stop.
highway.translationZh: 他在高速公路休息站的垃圾堆里发现了这些画作。

habitat.sentenceEn: It concluded that pandas fail to wander off in search of new mates if they find their habitat too comfortable, resulting in a lack of vital genetic diversity.
habitat.translationZh: 研究得出结论，若大熊猫觉得栖息地过于舒适，它们便不会离开去寻找新的配偶，从而导致关键遗传多样性的缺乏。
habitat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

habitat.sentenceEn: The ideal level of perfectly livable habitat was found to be only 80% of an area, with the remainder either too harsh or too affected by human activity.
habitat.translationZh: 研究发现，完全适宜居住的理想栖息地面积仅占区域总面积的80%，其余部分要么环境过于恶劣，要么受人类活动影响过大。
habitat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

habitat.sentenceEn: Environmentalists have long believed that building roads or homes near the bears may threaten their survival by "reducing or fragmenting their natural: habitats ", The Times reported.
habitat.translationZh: 《泰晤士报》报道，环保人士长期以来认为，在熊类栖息地附近修建道路或房屋可能会通过“减少或分割它们的自然栖息地”来威胁其生存。
habitat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

habitat.sentenceEn: These farms will then have to be shifted to cooler mountainous areas, which are the natural habitat of wildlife.
habitat.translationZh: 这些农场将不得不迁往更凉爽的山区，而那里正是野生动物的自然栖息地。
habitat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

habitat.sentenceEn: What does the woman say has caused the shrinking of ducks' habitats in Australia?
habitat.translationZh: 女士说澳大利亚鸭子栖息地缩小的原因是什么？

habitat.sentenceEn: They may not adapt to the fragmentation of their habitat .
habitat.translationZh: 它们可能无法适应栖息地的碎片化。

hinder.sentenceEn: This commitment, one right way of thinking or doing things, hinders the manager's flexibility.
hinder.translationZh: 这种固执于某种单一思维或办事方式的做法，阻碍了管理者的灵活性。
hinder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

hinder.sentenceEn: Not only does this tendency hinder their growth and performance, it can lead to harmful relationships, both personally and professionally.
hinder.translationZh: 这种倾向不仅阻碍他们的成长和表现，还可能在个人和职业层面导致不良的人际关系。
hinder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

hinder.sentenceEn: This is problematic because it hinders your ability to adapt to new circumstances, which is vital if you want to be a successful entrepreneur.
hinder.translationZh: 这是个问题，因为它会阻碍你适应新环境的能力，而这种能力对于想要成为成功企业家的人来说至关重要。
hinder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

hinder.sentenceEn: After all, competitive rivalry can also hinder effective decision-making and increase your willingness to take risks, behaviors that can ultimately hurt your venture's success.
hinder.translationZh: 毕竟，竞争性对抗也可能阻碍有效决策，并增强你冒险的意愿，这些行为最终可能损害你的创业成功。
hinder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

hinder.sentenceEn: What might hinder real estate development in the U.S.?
hinder.translationZh: 什么可能会阻碍美国的房地产发展？

hinder.sentenceEn: It hinders them from getting ahead.
hinder.translationZh: 这阻碍了他们取得进展。

hunger.sentenceEn: Despite decades of effort to eliminate hunger , the latest estimate is that about 11% of people on the planet (about 820 million people) are suffering daily undernourishment.
hunger.translationZh: 尽管数十年来一直在努力消除饥饿，但最新估计显示，全球约11%的人口（约8.2亿人）每天都在遭受营养不良的困扰。
hunger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

hunger.sentenceEn: By sharing knowledge of agriculture and climate with peers in countries most vulnerable to poverty and hunger , scientists can help reduce these problems.
hunger.translationZh: 通过与最易受贫困和饥饿影响国家的同行分享农业和气候方面的知识，科学家们可以帮助缓解这些问题。
hunger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

hunger.sentenceEn: "A balanced breakfast is really helpful, but getting regular meals throughout the day is more important to leave blood sugar stable through the day, which helps control weight and hunger levels," says Elder.
hunger.translationZh: 埃尔德表示：“均衡的早餐确实很有帮助，但全天规律进餐更为重要，这能保持血糖稳定，有助于控制体重和饥饿感。”

hunger.sentenceEn: Hunger also outweighed the mice's social needs, the researchers found.
hunger.translationZh: 研究人员发现，饥饿感也战胜了老鼠的社交需求。
hunger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

hunger.sentenceEn: How can scientists help cope with poverty and hunger ?
hunger.translationZh: 科学家如何帮助应对贫困和饥饿问题？

hunger.sentenceEn: Have meals as usual to stay away from hunger .

honor.sentenceEn: Earth Day is an annual celebration that honors the achievements of the environmental movement and raises awareness of the need to protect Earth's natural resources for future generations.
honor.translationZh: 世界地球日是一项年度纪念活动，旨在赞颂环保运动所取得的成就，并提高人们保护地球自然资源以造福子孙后代的意识。
honor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

honor.sentenceEn: Last night, we were honored to be awarded three Michelin stars for the 11th year in a row.
honor.translationZh: 昨晚，我们很荣幸连续第11年获得米其林三星殊荣。
honor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

honor.sentenceEn: A person's word is linked to their honor , so verbal agreements are seen as important, whereas written contracts are taken as memos of understanding.
honor.translationZh: 一个人的承诺与其名誉息息相关，因此口头协议被视为至关重要，而书面合同则仅被视作理解备忘录。
honor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

honor.sentenceEn: Today, consulting or freelancing for five businesses at the same time is a badge of honor .
honor.translationZh: 如今，同时为五家企业提供咨询服务或从事自由职业已成为一种荣誉的象征。
honor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

honor.sentenceEn: UNESCO considers the entire city a World Heritage Site, a great honor that means Venice, at the cultural level, belongs to all of the world's people.
honor.translationZh: 联合国教科文组织将整个威尼斯城列为世界遗产，这是一项崇高的荣誉，意味着从文化层面而言，威尼斯属于全世界人民。

honor.sentenceEn: See them as symbols of honor .
honor.translationZh: 将奖牌视为荣誉的象征。

helicopter.sentenceEn: The former British Army Air Corps helicopter pilot was selected as a European Space Agency astronaut in 2009.
helicopter.translationZh: 这位前英国陆军航空兵团直升机飞行员于2009年被选为欧洲航天局宇航员。
helicopter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

helicopter.sentenceEn: Helicopter taxi is not an affordable option for many travelers.
helicopter.translationZh: 直升机出租车并非许多旅客负担得起的选择。
helicopter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

helicopter.sentenceEn: Customers can book their helicopter ride through a mobile app.
helicopter.translationZh: 乘客可通过手机应用程序预订直升机行程。
helicopter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

helicopter.sentenceEn: India launched its helicopter taxi service on Monday, promising to ferry customers the 40 miles between Bangalore's Electronic City tech hub and the International Airport terminal in 15 minutes.
helicopter.translationZh: 印度于周一推出了直升机出租车服务，承诺将乘客从班加罗尔电子城科技中心运送至国际机场航站楼，全程40英里仅需15分钟。
helicopter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

helicopter.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the news report about the helicopter taxi ride?
helicopter.translationZh: 从这篇新闻报道中，我们能了解到关于直升机出租车服务的哪些信息？

helicopter.sentenceEn: He used to be a helicopter pilot.
helicopter.translationZh: 他曾经是一名直升机飞行员。

host.sentenceEn: The board of free meals inside the restaurant shows a host of potential meals already paid for by customers, each costing about $10.
host.translationZh: 餐厅内的免费餐食公告板上展示着许多已由顾客付费的待用餐食，每份价格约为10美元。
host.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

host.sentenceEn: M: Didn't South Africa host the Football World Cup a few years ago?
host.translationZh: 男：南非几年前不是举办过足球世界杯吗？
host.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

host.sentenceEn: Online classes do not require buildings and each class can host hundreds of people simultaneously, resulting in greater savings, thus increasing the temptation of distance education for those concerned more about budgets than learning.
host.translationZh: 在线课程不需要教学楼，每个班级可以同时容纳数百人，从而节省更多开支，这使得远程教育对那些更关心预算而非学习的人更具诱惑力。
host.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

host.sentenceEn: "It is hopeless to report fake villa websites to the internet giants who host them," he says.
host.translationZh: 他说：“向托管这些虚假别墅网站的互联网巨头举报是徒劳的。”

host.sentenceEn: What is a host's responsibility regarding security cameras, according to Lizzie Post?
host.translationZh: 根据莉齐·波斯特的观点，主人在安全摄像头方面有什么责任？
收容国的不稳定性加剧

homeless.sentenceEn: For as long as there are homeless people, there is a tendency to blame the victims themselves for their condition—to see their failure to thrive as an issue of character, of moral weakness, of laziness.
homeless.translationZh: 只要存在无家可归者，人们往往就会将他们的处境归咎于其自身——将他们未能过上好生活视为性格问题、道德弱点或懒惰所致。
homeless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

homeless.sentenceEn: The purpose of such action is to fund an enormous multibillion-dollar, 10-year program of housing and social services for the homeless .
homeless.translationZh: 此举旨在为一项规模庞大、耗资数十亿美元的十年期计划提供资金，该计划为无家可归者提供住房和社会服务。
homeless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

homeless.sentenceEn: There are close to 58,000 homeless people in Los Angeles county.
homeless.translationZh: 洛杉矶县有近58,000名无家可归者。
homeless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

homeless.sentenceEn: But contrary to popular belief, the homeless in Los Angeles are not mostly mentally ill or drug addicted or frightening, although a sizable minority meet some of those descriptions.
homeless.translationZh: 但与普遍看法相反，洛杉矶的无家可归者并非大多患有精神疾病、吸毒成瘾或具有威胁性，尽管有相当一部分人符合其中某些描述。
homeless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

homeless.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the new Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority report?
homeless.translationZh: 我们能从洛杉矶无家可归者服务管理局的新报告中了解到什么？

homeless.sentenceEn: The increase in new housing falls short of the demand of the growing homeless population.
homeless.translationZh: 新增住房的增长无法满足日益增加的无家可归人口的需求。

hunt.sentenceEn: The revolutionary idea of a self-service grocery, where people could hunt and gather food from aisles rather than asking a clerk to fetch items from behind a counter, first came about in America.
hunt.translationZh: 自助杂货店这一革命性理念最早出现在美国——在这里，人们可以从货架通道自行挑选食物，而无需让店员从柜台后取货。
hunt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

hunt.sentenceEn: When you're hunting for a new job, you already know that the employer is trying to decide whether or not you're a good fit for the position.
hunt.translationZh: 当你在寻找新工作时，你已经知道雇主正在判断你是否适合这个职位。

hunt.sentenceEn: Like the Scooby crew, we may find ourselves hunting for an easy fix, one word for people who do bad things.
hunt.translationZh: 就像史酷比小队一样，我们可能也在寻求一个简单的解决办法——用一个词来概括那些做坏事的人。

hunt.sentenceEn: But for the Saharan silver ant, crawling from their underground nests into the sun's brutal rays to hunt for food, this is the perfect time to seek lunch.
hunt.translationZh: 但对于撒哈拉银蚁而言，这个时候却是它们爬出地下巢穴，顶着烈日外出觅食的绝佳时机。
hunt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

hunt.sentenceEn: What is characteristic of the way cats hunt , according to the Japanese researchers?
hunt.translationZh: 根据日本研究人员的说法，猫的捕猎方式有什么特点？

hunt.sentenceEn: They were hunted by Spanish and Russian explorers.
hunt.translationZh: 它们曾被西班牙和俄罗斯探险家猎杀。

heritage.sentenceEn: The area around Mahmudia, which is a UNESCO World Heritage site, is the third-most bio-diverse in the world, after Australia's Great Barrier Reef and the Galapagos Islands.
heritage.translationZh: 马赫穆迪亚周边地区是联合国教科文组织世界遗产地，也是全球第三大生物多样性地区，仅次于澳大利亚的大堡礁和加拉帕戈斯群岛。
heritage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

heritage.sentenceEn: They celebrate the cultural heritage of the country and will be available to view until Sunday.
heritage.translationZh: 这些壁画颂扬着该国的文化遗产，将展出至周日。
heritage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

heritage.sentenceEn: UNESCO considers the entire city a World Heritage Site, a great honor that means Venice, at the cultural level, belongs to all of the world's people.
heritage.translationZh: 联合国教科文组织将整个威尼斯城列为世界遗产，这是一项崇高的荣誉，意味着从文化层面而言，威尼斯属于全世界人民。

heritage.sentenceEn: Italy boasts more UNESCO World Heritage Sites than any other country in the world, granting it considerable power and influence within the organization.
heritage.translationZh: 意大利拥有的联合国教科文组织世界遗产数量超过世界上任何其他国家，这使其在该组织内拥有相当大的权力和影响力。

heritage.sentenceEn: She says the main reason the U.N. cultural organization didn't vote to declare Venice a World Heritage Site In Danger is because UNESCO has become "intensely politicized. There would have been some back-room negotiations."
heritage.translationZh: 她说，这个联合国文化组织没有投票宣布威尼斯为濒危世界遗产的主要原因是联合国教科文组织已变得“高度政治化。其中肯定有一些幕后谈判。”

heritage.sentenceEn: The heritage situation in Venice has been deteriorating in the past few years.
heritage.translationZh: 过去几年，威尼斯的遗产状况一直在恶化。

highlight.sentenceEn: Officials wanted to highlight South Dakota's two largest industries: tourism and agriculture.
highlight.translationZh: 官员们希望突出南达科他州的两大产业：旅游业和农业。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

highlight.sentenceEn: Such literary accomplishments highlight an important point.
highlight.translationZh: 这些文学成就凸显了一个重要观点。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

highlight.sentenceEn: The information will highlight what a great value they have for their very reasonable cost.
highlight.translationZh: 这些信息将突出展示，以如此合理的价格，它们具有多么高的价值。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

highlight.sentenceEn: Students are able to highlight and edit text, write notes and search for information much more quickly than they can with printed textbooks.
highlight.translationZh: 学生能够突出显示和编辑文本、做笔记以及搜索信息，这些操作都比使用纸质教科书快得多。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

highlight.sentenceEn: The study highlights an important relationship between our personalities and the wellbeing of our pets.
highlight.translationZh: 这项研究揭示了我们的性格与宠物健康之间的重要关系。
highlight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

heavily.sentenceEn: They heavily feature animals and other familiar sights, like images of people eating.
heavily.translationZh: 它们主要以动物和其他常见景象为特色，比如人们进食的画面。
heavily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

heavily.sentenceEn: Besides, teamwork and leadership rely heavily on the power of persuasion to get things done.
heavily.translationZh: 此外，团队合作和领导力在很大程度上依赖说服力来推动工作完成。
heavily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

heavily.sentenceEn: The pain will be especially acute in parts of the country that heavily rely on heating oil to keep homes warm.
heavily.translationZh: 对于该国那些严重依赖取暖油来为家庭供暖的地区，这种痛苦将尤为剧烈。
heavily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

heavily.sentenceEn: They found busy people are perceived to be of high status, and interestingly, these status attributions are heavily influenced by our own beliefs about social mobility.
heavily.translationZh: 他们发现，忙碌的人被认为地位较高，有趣的是，这种地位归因深受我们自身对社会流动性的信念影响。
heavily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

heavily.sentenceEn: Others elevate the egg into a fancy art, like the heavily jewel-covered "eggs" that were favored by the Russians starting in the 19th century.
heavily.translationZh: 也有些传统则将鸡蛋提升为精美的艺术品，例如19世纪起俄罗斯人所钟爱的、缀满珠宝的"彩蛋"。
heavily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

heavily.sentenceEn: They don't know they will be heavily fined.
heavily.translationZh: 他们不知道自己会被处以巨额罚款。

hunting.sentenceEn: M: But can anyone be sure if the decline is really caused by the hunting or by climate change?
hunting.translationZh: 男：但是谁能确定数量下降真的是由捕猎还是气候变化引起的呢？
hunting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

hunting.sentenceEn: M: No, duck hunting seemingly exists as the continuation of a tradition.
hunting.translationZh: 男：是啊，猎鸭活动似乎只是作为一种传统的延续而存在。
hunting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

hunting.sentenceEn: M: What do they use for hunting during that period?
hunting.translationZh: 男：那时候他们用什么打猎呢？
hunting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

hunting.sentenceEn: He told me hunting ducks and geese began in the 19th century.
hunting.translationZh: 他告诉我，猎杀鸭鹅的活动始于19世纪。
hunting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

hunting.sentenceEn: W: I can't believe that duck hunting is still legal in so many parts of the world.
hunting.translationZh: 女：真不敢相信，猎鸭在世界上这么多地方仍然是合法的。
hunting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

hunting.sentenceEn: Duck hunting remains legal in many parts of the world.
hunting.translationZh: 猎鸭在世界许多地区仍然是合法的。

halt.sentenceEn: Eventually, the cars far behind are forced to stop completely or risk hitting the slower vehicles ahead—and so the traffic grinds to a halt over nothing, Horn said.
halt.translationZh: 霍恩表示，最终，远远落后的车辆被迫完全停下来，否则就有撞上前方慢车的风险——就这样，一场毫无缘由的交通拥堵便形成了。

halt.sentenceEn: These are generally known as "phantom" traffic jams, in which dense traffic crawls to a halt for no apparent reason at all.
halt.translationZh: 这些通常被称为“幽灵”交通拥堵，即密集的车流毫无明显原因地缓慢停滞。

halt.sentenceEn: A company spokesperson said the operations at the site had been halted while the investigation is ongoing and that the break had posed no safety threat to workers.
halt.translationZh: 公司发言人表示，在调查进行期间，该矿场的作业已暂停，此次溃坝未对工人构成安全威胁。
halt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

halt.sentenceEn: Police said that the car had come to a halt after hitting the sign, but did not appear to be seriously damaged, although an ambulance was called to check on the pensioner.
halt.translationZh: 警方表示，这辆车撞到指示牌后停了下来，看起来没有严重损坏，但还是叫了救护车来检查这位老人的情况。
halt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

halt.sentenceEn: When did the speaker's dancing life come to a halt ?
halt.translationZh: 说话者的舞蹈生涯何时中断的？

halt.sentenceEn: It brought the mine's operations to a halt .
halt.translationZh: 这导致该矿场的运营陷入停顿。

harmony.sentenceEn: The most major indicator of classical music's importance in society today is the fact that much of the popular music that is currently being produced uses similar beats, harmonies , and melodies(旋律) as those that were used in some of classical music's best works.
harmony.translationZh: 古典音乐在当今社会重要性的最主要指标是，当前制作的许多流行音乐使用的节拍、和声与旋律，与一些古典音乐杰作中使用的相似。
harmony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

harmony.sentenceEn: Without conflict, we're often stuck in this artificial harmony where people don't express potentially innovative ideas for fear that they may start conflict with others.
harmony.translationZh: 没有冲突，我们往往会陷入一种虚假的和谐中——人们因担心可能引发冲突而不愿表达那些具有潜在创新性的想法。
harmony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

harmony.sentenceEn: But this kind of artificial harmony isn't the answer.
harmony.translationZh: 但这种人为的和谐并非解决之道。
harmony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

harmony.sentenceEn: But too often we get caught in this place where conflict is perceived to be negative—something we want to avoid so that we can maintain the harmony of our workplace.
harmony.translationZh: 但我们常常陷入这样一种境地：将冲突视为负面的东西——我们想要避免的事情，以便维持工作场所的和谐。
harmony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

harmony.sentenceEn: The dancers move in harmony as they imitate the animal's natural movements in the wild, including the aggressiveness of an attack.
harmony.translationZh: 舞者们协调一致地模仿狮子在野外的自然动作，包括发起攻击时的凶猛姿态。

harmony.sentenceEn: They see such exercises as harmful to harmony .
harmony.translationZh: 他们认为这类活动对和谐有害。

hurricane.sentenceEn: Students in North Carolina already have several make-up days scheduled because of school closures during Hurricane Florence, which struck in September.
hurricane.translationZh: 北卡罗来纳州的学生们已经安排了几个补课日，以弥补9月份飓风佛罗伦萨袭击期间学校停课造成的损失。

hurricane.sentenceEn: It's Ken Outlaw, a welder in rural North Carolina whose dream of going back to school at a local community college was dashed by Hurricane Florence—just one of the extreme weather events that have tipped the balance for struggling Americans across the nation.
hurricane.translationZh: 比如肯·奥特洛，这位北卡罗来纳州农村的焊工，他重返当地社区大学深造的梦想被佛罗伦萨飓风无情击碎——这只是众多极端天气事件之一，这些事件让全美各地本已举步维艰的美国人雪上加霜。

hurricane.sentenceEn: After Hurricane Florence and Hurricane Michael last fall, USPS worked with state and local election boards to make sure that absentee ballots were available and received on time.
hurricane.translationZh: 去年秋天，在佛罗伦萨飓风和迈克尔飓风过后，美国邮政局与州和地方选举委员会合作，确保缺席选票能够及时送达并被接收。

hurricane.sentenceEn: Last October, the company pledged $1 million in cash and transportation support for Hurricanes Florence and Michael.
hurricane.translationZh: 去年10月，该公司承诺为佛罗伦萨飓风和迈克尔飓风提供100万美元现金和运输支持。

hurricane.sentenceEn: As my colleague Vann Newkirk reported, Puerto Rico is still confronting economic and structural destruction and resource scarcity from 2017's Hurricane Maria.
hurricane.translationZh: 正如我的同事范恩·纽柯克所报道的那样，波多黎各仍在应对2017年玛丽亚飓风造成的经济和结构性破坏以及资源短缺问题。

hurricane.sentenceEn: After Hurricane Katrina interrupted routine delivery, temporary mail service points were set up.
hurricane.translationZh: 卡特里娜飓风中断常规投递后，临时邮件服务点被设立起来。

hyphenate.sentenceEn: Most of the time, though, the most popular compromise is to hyphenate your last name and the last name of your groom.
hyphenate.translationZh: 不过，大多数情况下，最受欢迎的折中方案是将自己的姓氏与新郎的姓氏用连字符连接。

hyphenate.sentenceEn: For example, many women who choose to hyphenate do so partially because they have earned higher educational degrees and certifications under their maiden names.
hyphenate.translationZh: 例如，许多选择使用连字符组合姓氏的女性这样做，部分原因是她们的高等教育学位和专业证书都是用婚前姓氏获得的。

hyphenate.sentenceEn: There are all sorts of reasons to hyphenate your name or not to hyphenate your name.
hyphenate.translationZh: 选择连字符组合姓氏或不选择连字符组合姓氏，都各有其原因。

hyphenate.sentenceEn: Hyphenating your last name can help you bridge the gap between your personal and professional lives.
hyphenate.translationZh: 使用连字符连接姓氏有助于弥合个人生活与职业生活之间的差距。

hyphenate.sentenceEn: Hyphenating the two names is a way for each person to, at least a little bit, "win" the argument.
hyphenate.translationZh: 将双方姓氏用连字符连接，能让每个人都在这场争论中至少获得一点“胜利”。

hyphenate.sentenceEn: Hyphenating the last names could be a win-win solution should arguments arise about what name to adopt upon marriage.
hyphenate.translationZh: 若婚后对采用何种姓氏产生争议，将双方姓氏连字符合并可能是一个双赢的解决方案。

historical.sentenceEn: That's a month earlier than normal and something that's happened only once before in the historical record in 2016.
historical.translationZh: 这比正常情况提前了一个月，在历史记录中，这种情况此前只在2016年发生过一次。
historical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

historical.sentenceEn: But, in a historical sense, number-conscious people like us are the unusual ones.
historical.translationZh: 但是，从历史角度来看，像我们这样有数字意识的人反而是少数。

historical.sentenceEn: There's a lot on the internet about a state-wide ban in Florida, but a few days worth of digging by a historian at the Florida State Historical Society found no such legislation.
historical.translationZh: 互联网上有很多关于佛罗里达州全州范围内禁令的说法，但佛罗里达州历史学会的一位历史学家经过几天的深入调查，并未发现任何此类立法。

historical.sentenceEn: Few volcanoes in the world have an eruption history so thoroughly documented by historical records — Etna's eruption history dates back as far as 1500 BC.
historical.translationZh: 世界上很少有火山的喷发历史能像埃特纳火山这样被历史记录完整记载——其喷发历史可追溯至公元前1500年。
historical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

historical.sentenceEn: No Asian Americans were included in the list of historical figures recommended for study in K-12 classrooms.
historical.translationZh: 在K-12课堂推荐学习的历史人物名单中，没有亚裔美国人。

historical.sentenceEn: It is an old city with many sites of historical interest.
historical.translationZh: 这是一座拥有众多历史名胜的古城。

hormone.sentenceEn: Wearing power clothing makes us feel more confident and even increases hormones needed for displaying dominance.
hormone.translationZh: 穿着有力量感的服装能让我们感觉更自信，甚至会增加展现主导力所需的荷尔蒙。
hormone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

hormone.sentenceEn: The scientists measured concentrations of stress hormones in the students' saliva(唾液) before and after the talk.
hormone.translationZh: 科学家们在演讲前后分别测量了学生唾液中压力荷尔蒙的浓度。
hormone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

hormone.sentenceEn: If students believed that intelligence could improve—that is to say, when they held more of a growth mindset of intelligence—they showed lower levels of stress hormones when their grades were declining.
hormone.translationZh: 如果学生相信智力可以提升——也就是说，当他们持有更强的智力成长型思维模式时——他们在成绩下降时表现出的压力荷尔蒙水平较低。

hormone.sentenceEn: Instead, declining grades only predicted worse stress hormones among students who believed that worsening grades were a permanent and hopeless state of affairs.
hormone.translationZh: 相反，只有当学生认为成绩下降是一种永久且无望的状况时，成绩下降才会导致压力荷尔蒙水平升高。

hormone.sentenceEn: Students who believed that intelligence is fixed—that you are stuck being "not smart" if you struggle in school—showed higher levels of stress hormones when their grades were declining at the beginning of the ninth grade.
hormone.translationZh: 那些认为智力是固定不变的学生——即如果在学校学习遇到困难就会一直“不聪明”的学生——在九年级伊始成绩下滑时，表现出更高水平的压力荷尔蒙。

hormone.sentenceEn: We then assessed biological stress responses for students whose grades were dropping by examining their stress hormones (荷尔蒙).
hormone.translationZh: 然后，我们通过检测学生的压力荷尔蒙来评估成绩下滑学生的生理压力反应。

harvest.sentenceEn: Storms and floods in its main potato-growing region last year caused the worst harvest in more than 3 decades.
harvest.translationZh: 去年，日本主要马铃薯种植区遭遇暴风雨和洪水侵袭，导致了三十多年来最严重的减产。
harvest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

harvest.sentenceEn: A decorated egg thrown into the field would be a wish for a good harvest .
harvest.translationZh: 将彩蛋抛入田野，是祈求丰收的美好愿望。
harvest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

harvest.sentenceEn: A fourth of this year's U.S. grain harvest will go to fuel cars.
harvest.translationZh: 今年美国四分之一的粮食收成将用于为汽车提供燃料。

harvest.sentenceEn: In 1972, for instance, the Soviets, recognizing their poor harvest early, quietly cornered the world wheat market.
harvest.translationZh: 例如，1972年，苏联人早早意识到当年收成不佳，便悄悄垄断了全球小麦市场。

harvest.sentenceEn: And the rises were short-lived: prices typically returned to normal with the next harvest .
harvest.translationZh: 而且价格上涨只是暂时的：通常到下一季收成时，价格就会恢复正常。

harvest.sentenceEn: A quarter of this year's American grain harvest will be used to produce bio-fuel for cars.
harvest.translationZh: 今年美国四分之一的粮食收成将用于为汽车生产生物燃料。

hearing.sentenceEn: Scientists have known that depriving adult mice of vision can increase the sensitivity of individual neurons(神经元) in the part of the brain devoted to hearing .
hearing.translationZh: 科学家们已经发现，剥夺成年小鼠的视觉会提高其大脑听觉区域单个神经元的敏感性。
hearing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

hearing.sentenceEn: Kanold's earlier research disproved this idea by showing that depriving adult mice of vision for a short period increased the sensitivity of individual neurons in the auditory cortex(皮质), which is devoted to hearing .
hearing.translationZh: 卡诺尔德早期的研究反驳了这一观点，他通过实验表明，短期剥夺成年小鼠的视觉会提高听觉皮质中单个神经元的敏感性，而听觉皮质正是负责处理听觉信息的区域。
hearing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

hearing.sentenceEn: New Tech coupled with improvements in hearing aid technology and medical advances means that Miller is able to focus far more on his work.
hearing.translationZh: 新技术与助听器技术的改进以及医疗进步相结合，使米勒能够将更多精力专注于工作上。
hearing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

hearing.sentenceEn: It gives him a degree of hearing , and he can use a variety of communication methods depending on the situation.
hearing.translationZh: 这款微型助听设备让他恢复了一定程度的听力，使他能够根据不同场合灵活使用多种沟通方式。
hearing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

hearing.sentenceEn: He has benefited to a great extent from a tiny hearing device in his ear.
hearing.translationZh: 他从耳朵里佩戴的微型助听设备中受益匪浅。
hearing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

hearing.sentenceEn: They rely mainly on their hearing .
hearing.translationZh: 它们主要依靠自己的听觉。

hidden.sentenceEn: The book The Hidden Persuaders, published in 1957, warned that supermarkets were putting women in a "hypnoidal trance(催眠恍惚状态)," causing them to wander aisles bumping into boxes and "picking things off shelves at random."
hidden.translationZh: 1957年出版的《隐性说服者》一书警告称，超市正让女性陷入一种“催眠恍惚状态”，使她们在过道里漫无目的地游荡，撞到货架上的箱子，并“随意从货架上挑选商品”。
hidden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

hidden.sentenceEn: Physically attending school has hidden benefits: getting up every morning, interacting with peers, and building relationships with teachers are essential skills to cultivate in young people.
hidden.translationZh: 亲身到校上课有诸多隐性益处：每天早起、与同龄人互动以及与老师建立关系，这些都是年轻人需要培养的基本技能。
hidden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

hidden.sentenceEn: So what hidden costs should low-income students really be paying attention to?
hidden.translationZh: 那么，低收入学生究竟应该注意哪些隐藏成本呢？

hidden.sentenceEn: In the grand scheme of things, however, colleges also must come to understand that the hidden fees they ask for may prove unmanageable for the very kinds of low-income or first-generation students they are trying desperately to attract.
hidden.translationZh: 然而，从全局来看，大学也必须认识到，他们所收取的这些隐性费用，对于那些他们正竭力吸引的低收入学生或第一代大学生而言，可能是难以承受的。

hidden.sentenceEn: They will also carry with them a huge student loan debt, in addition to countless " hidden " out-of-pocket costs paid for by their bank accounts and the bank accounts of their families.
hidden.translationZh: 除了银行账户和家庭银行账户支付的无数"隐性"自付费用外，他们还将背负巨额学生贷款债务。

hidden.sentenceEn: Its hidden biases should be identified independently.
hidden.translationZh: 其隐藏的偏见应当被独立识别出来。

hmm.sentenceEn: W: Hmm , could you send me his number, please?
hmm.translationZh: 女：嗯，能把他的号码发给我吗？
hmm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

hmm.sentenceEn: M: Hmm … I don't know if that's a good idea as your mother and I would worry about you living all by yourself in an apartment so far from home.
hmm.translationZh: 嗯……我不确定这是不是个好主意，因为你妈妈和我会担心你一个人住在离家这么远的公寓里。
hmm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

hmm.sentenceEn: W: Hmm , that's nice of you, but I don't want to feel obliged to buy one of his cars.
hmm.translationZh: 女：嗯，你真好，但我不想觉得非得买他的车不可。
hmm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

hmm.sentenceEn: W: Hmm , isn't that sort of thing usually covered by insurance?
hmm.translationZh: 女：嗯，这种事情不通常都是由保险覆盖的吗？
hmm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

hmm.sentenceEn: M: Hmm , I'd be a bit worried about his reaction.
hmm.translationZh: 嗯，我有点担心他的反应。
hmm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第1句

hmm.sentenceEn: W: Hmm , what are the boards actually made of?
hmm.translationZh: 嗯，这些绘图板究竟是用什么做的？
hmm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第1句

holidaymaker.sentenceEn: "Millions of pounds are lost each year by defrauded holidaymakers ," says Sean Tipton of the Association of British Travel Agents (ABTA).
holidaymaker.translationZh: 英国旅行社协会（ABTA）的肖恩·蒂普顿表示：“每年都有数百万英镑被度假诈骗受害者损失。”

holidaymaker.sentenceEn: The island is often described as heaven on earth by holidaymakers .
holidaymaker.translationZh: 这座岛屿常被度假者形容为人间天堂。
holidaymaker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

holidaymaker.sentenceEn: Holidaymakers have been alerted to the frequent occurrence of online villa-booking frauds.
holidaymaker.translationZh: 度假者已被提醒注意在线别墅预订诈骗的频繁发生。

honestly.sentenceEn: M: Honestly , I agree, but just don't let him hear you say that.
honestly.translationZh: M：说实话，我同意你的看法，但千万别让他听到你这么说。
honestly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

honestly.sentenceEn: W: Honestly , look at my face.
honestly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

honestly.sentenceEn: Honestly , I hear the same answer from the vast majority of people I meet.
honestly.translationZh: 说实话，我从遇到的绝大多数人那里听到的都是同样的答案。
honestly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

honestly.sentenceEn: But honestly , I've just seen too many horrible accidents involving those dangerous monsters.
honestly.translationZh: 但说实话，我见过太多涉及那些危险家伙的可怕事故了。
honestly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句
文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

honestly.sentenceEn: When they interact, they aren't afraid to smell each other and will express themselves clearly and honestly .
honestly.translationZh: 当它们互动时，它们不怕互相嗅闻，并且会清晰、诚实地表达自己。
honestly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

humanity.sentenceEn: Such planting is a small step for humanity —in the right direction.
humanity.translationZh: 这样的种植是人类迈出的一小步——但却是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。
humanity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

humanity.sentenceEn: Another potential climate change-induced problem is our dependence on commodity crops—wheat, soybeans, corn and rice—which currently provide humanity with 75% of its calories, either directly or indirectly through the animals we raise on those crops.
humanity.translationZh: 气候变化引发的另一个潜在问题是我们对大宗商品作物的依赖——小麦、大豆、玉米和水稻——这些作物目前直接或通过我们用它们饲养的动物间接为人类提供75%的热量。

humanity.sentenceEn: The power of the classroom is rooted in the humanity of the people gathered in the same place, at the same time.
humanity.translationZh: 课堂的力量源于在同一时间、同一地点相聚的人们所展现的人性。
humanity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

humanity.sentenceEn: In coeducational schools, girls are often expected to succeed only in humanities or the arts.
humanity.translationZh: 在男女同校的学校里，人们通常期望女孩只在人文或艺术领域取得成功。
humanity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

humanity.sentenceEn: We will lose a vital part of what has made humanity as a whole so successful as a species.
humanity.translationZh: 我们将失去使人类作为一个物种取得巨大成功的关键要素。

humanity.sentenceEn: They are more likely to succeed in the humanities .
humanity.translationZh: 她们更有可能在人文学科取得成功。
